request.query: For a finitely supported function and a zero preserving size function its sum is equal to sum over any finite superset of support

items.informal_name: Sum over Finite Support Subset with Zero-Respecting Function
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_8} {N : Type u_10} [inst : Zero M] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid N] (f : α →₀ M) {s : Finset α},
  f.support ⊆ s → ∀ (g : α → M → N), (∀ i ∈ s, g i 0 = 0) → f.sum g = ∑ x ∈ s, g x (f x)
items.informal_description: Let $\alpha$ and $M$ be types with $M$ equipped with a zero element, and let $N$ be an additive commutative monoid. For any finite support function $f : \alpha \to_0 M$ whose support is contained in a finite set $s \subseteq \alpha$, and for any function $g : \alpha \to M \to N$ satisfying $g(i, 0) = 0$ for all $i \in s$, the sum of $g$ applied to $f$ equals the sum of $g(x, f(x))$ over all $x \in s$. Formally, $\sum_{x \in s} g(x, f(x)) = f.\text{sum}(g)$.

items.informal_name: Equality of Finite Sums When Support is Contained in a Finset
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_5} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] (f : α → M) (hf : (Function.support f).Finite) {s : Finset α},
  hf.toFinset ⊆ s → ∑ᶠ (i : α), f i = ∑ i ∈ s, f i
items.informal_description: For a function $ f : \alpha \to M $ with finite support in an additive commutative monoid $ M $, if the Finset corresponding to the support of $ f $ is a subset of a Finset $ s $, then the finite sum $ \sum^\ast_{i} f(i) $ equals the sum $ \sum_{i \in s} f(i) $.

items.informal_name: Finite Sum over Support Equals Total Sum in Additive Commutative Monoid
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_5} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] (f : α → M),
  ∑ᶠ (a : α) (_ : a ∈ Function.support f), f a = ∑ᶠ (a : α), f a
items.informal_description: For any function $ f : \alpha \to M $ where $ M $ is an additive commutative monoid, the finite sum $ \sum_{a \in \alpha} f(a) $ is equal to the finite sum $ \sum_{a \in \text{supp}(f)} f(a) $, where $ \text{supp}(f) = \{a \in \alpha \mid f(a) \neq 0\} $.

items.informal_name: Equality of Finsum and Finite Sum When Support is Contained in a Finite Set
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_5} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] (f : α → M) {s : Set α},
  Function.support f ⊆ s → ∀ (hs : s.Finite), ∑ᶠ (i : α), f i = ∑ i ∈ hs.toFinset, f i
items.informal_description: For any function $ f : \alpha \to M $ where $ M $ is an additive commutative monoid, if the support of $ f $ (i.e., the set $ \{x \in \alpha \mid f(x) \neq 0\} $) is contained in a finite set $ s $, then the finsum $ \sum^\mathrlap{f} f(i) $ over $ \alpha $ equals the finite sum $ \sum_{i \in s} f(i) $.

items.informal_name: Equality of Finsum and Finset Sum When Support is Contained
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_5} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] (f : α → M) {s : Finset α},
  Function.support f ⊆ ↑s → ∑ᶠ (i : α), f i = ∑ i ∈ s, f i
items.informal_description: If the support of a function $ f : \alpha \to M $ is contained within a finite set $ s $, then the finsum of $ f $ is equal to the sum of $ f $ over $ s $. Formally, $ \sum^\infty_{i \in \alpha} f(i) = \sum_{i \in s} f(i) $ provided $ \mathrm{supp}(f) \subseteq s $.

items.informal_name: Equality of Sums over Finite Support and Finite Set
items.informal_description: For a finite set $ s $ of elements of type $ \alpha $, a function $ f : \alpha \to M $, and a function $ g : \alpha \to M \to N $ satisfying $ g(a, 0) = 0 $ for all $ a $, the sum of $ g $ evaluated on the finite support function constructed from $ s $ and $ f $ (which is non-zero only on $ s $) equals the sum over $ s $ of $ g(a, f(a)) $. This holds under the condition that $ f(a) \neq 0 $ implies $ a \in s $.

items.type:

  Function.support f ⊆ ↑s → ∑ᶠ (i : α), f i = ∑ i ∈ s, f i
items.informal_description: For any function $f : \alpha \to M$ where $M$ is an additive commutative monoid, if the support of $f$ is contained in a finite set $s$, then the finsum of $f$ equals the sum of $f$ over $s$. Formally, if $\operatorname{supp}(f) \subseteq s$, then $\sum^\mathsf{fin} f(i) = \sum_{i \in s} f(i)$.

items.informal_description: Let $ M $ be an additive commutative monoid and $ \alpha $ a type. For any function $ f : \alpha \to M $ with finite support, if the support of $ f $ (converted to a finite set) is a subset of a finite set $ s $, then the sum of $ f $ over all $ \alpha $ (denoted $ \sum^\infty f(i) $) equals the sum of $ f $ over the elements of $ s $, i.e., $ \sum_{i \in s} f(i) $.
